generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
If the documents are not certified by the competent authority as prescribed in this notification and tender documents, the same will not be considered for evaluation.
During the time of technical evaluation, if the employer finds that any certificate/ information furnished is false such bidders will be disqualified and barred from participating in the bid.

labourcess 1% as per provision of building and the construction works welfare Act 1996 will be recovered from each running bill of the contractor. Royalty Charges will be deducted from the running bills at prevailing rates.
TDS and Taxes will be deducted from each running bill as applicable.
Conditional tenders are liable to be rejected.
Any Addendum/Corrigendum will be published in e-portal only.
The tender is open tender, Any eligible contractor may participate
Any other conditions as in Tender Notification& Tender document shall be applicable

technicalCriterionList.description: Valid Registration certificate as Class-IV and above civil contractors registered in PWD/ WRD/PRED.
Copy of Valid GST Registration Certificate
EPF Registration Certificate with latest month challan receipt Sep-2026/Oct-2026
Income tax return for the assement year 2025-26.
Liquid assets and /or availability of credit facilities from Nationalised Banks of Rs.1.42 lakhs

The abstract of total value of only civil engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years 2021-22 to 2025-26 duly certified by the Chartered Accountant in the given format given in section 3 of tender document with UDIN shall be uploaded. Maximum value of only civil engineering construction works executed in any one year during the last five years 2021-22 to 2025-26 will be taken into consideration for calculating Assessed available tender capacity.

The statements showing the value of existing commitments and on-going works as well as the stipulated period of completion remaining for each of the works listed should be countersigned by the Employer in charge, not below the rank of an Executive Engineer or equivalent.
Works for which Tenders already submitted.
Accurate Address, Phone Number, Mail id of the tenderer should be Uploaded
Eligible Tenderers will be qualified only if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value as per the formula provided in the bid document.

itemList.description:
Cutting and burning or disposing off Apu / Jondu from marshy areas 
as directed with all other ancillary operations complete. as per the direction of Engineer in charge of work

Earth work excavation by manual means for drains,canals, waste weir, draft, approach channels, key trenches, foundation of buildings and bridges and such simillar works in all kinds of soils , as per drawing and technical specifications, including setting out, shoring, strutting, barricading, caution lights, removal of stumps and other deleterious matter, excavated surface leveled and sides neatly dressed disposing off the excavated stuff or sorting & stacking the selected stuff for reuse in a radius of 50 m and lift upto 1.5 m including cost of labour, tools & other appurtenaces required to complete the work. in all kinds of soils depth uptp 1.5 M As per the direction of Engineer incharge of work.

Supplying P-3 Class R.C.C spun pipes ( safe for 6 kg / cm2 test pressure ) to work spot including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, taxes, duties, levies, royalty & all necessary works as applicable as per specification 500 mm dia P-3 Class R.C.C spun pipe As per the direction of Engineer incharge of work.

Providing compacted embankment for field irrigation channels with gravely soil from approved borrow area in layers of 100 to 150 mm thickness (before compaction) including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, all other operations such as collection of soil, spreading in layer of specified thickness, sorting-out, breaking clods, levelling, watering, compacting as directed , dressing sides to required slope and all other anciliery operation etc., complete with all lead and all lifts As per the direction of Engineer incharge of work.

Providing & constructing 250 mm thick dry rubble stone pitching pin headers at 2 per sqm using stones and stone chips from approved source including cost of all materials, labour, hand packing / wedging stone chips, finishing and all other ancillary operations complete with all lead and lifts. As per the direction of Engineer incharge of work.

Providing and laying in position cement concrete for levelling course for all works in foundation. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed, laid in layers not exceeding 150 mm thickness, well compacted using plate vibrators, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials of quality, labour, Usage charges of machineries, curing, and all the other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. Mix 1:3:6 (M10) Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates As per the direction of Engineer incharge of work.
